PLAN "12-Week Postpartum Return Program (Home; 33y female; 4 weeks post-C-section; light activity only)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Safe progression for postnatal return with pelvic floor and core considerations"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 25m "Gentle Mobility & Core-Adaptation":
        warmup:
          None
        main straight_sets:
          pelvic_floor_breathing 2x8..12 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3x6 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow_flow 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 25m "Low-Impact Lower-Body Prep":
        warmup:
          march_in_place 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          glute_activation_bridge_2x10 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
          bodyweight_squat_tap_to_support 2x8 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_seq 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 25m "Light Mobility & Posture":
        warmup:
          shoulder_rolls 2 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          wall_slide_scapular 2x8 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
          hip_hinge_to_box 2x8 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_opening 5 minutes
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Breath-Driven Core & Pelvic Floor":
        warmup:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          pelvic_floor_breathing_flow 3x8..12 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
          bird_dog_knee_wo 2x6 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose_to_table_8_minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Glute & Core Light Activation":
        warmup:
          ankle_to_neck_roll 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge_hold 2x6 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
          heaps_of_stability_leg_lowering 2x6 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          figure_4_stretch 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 30m "Posture & Mobility":
        warmup:
          marches 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          wall_push_ups_knee 2x6 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
          prone_cc_downward_dog_prep 2x6 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose_to_creath 5 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Gentle Loading & Core Integration":
        warmup:
          pelvic_floor_breathing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          reverse_lunge_support 2x6 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
          dead_bug_mod 3x8..12 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_release 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Upper Body Foundation (no load)":
        warmup:
          scapula_mups 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_row_mod 2x8 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
          bicep_curl_no_weight 2x8 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch_series 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 35m "Mobility & Breath Coherence":
        warmup:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 4 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          thoracic_rotation_sop 2x8 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
          hip_hinge_light_to_squat 2x8 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose_flow 6 minutes
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Stability & Foundations":
        warmup:
          cat_cow_flow 4 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          side_plank_knee_support 2x6 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
          glute_bridge_progression 3x8 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          lying_spinal_twist 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Cardio-lite & Core Interaction":
        warmup:
          marching_around_home 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          step_touch_squat 3x8 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
          dead_bug_with_opposition 3x8 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          breathing_focus_5_minutes
      DAY Friday training 40m "Recovery & Posture":
        warmup:
          shoulder_optimizers 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Snow_angle_scapular_cAF 2x8 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
          wall_slide_2.0 2x8 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          yin_mobility_sequence 6 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Progressive Resistance with Bodyweight":
        warmup:
          light_walk 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat_no_load 3x8 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
          push_up_from_knee 3x6 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_openers_5_minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Core Activation & Stability":
        warmup:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug_with_hand_contact 3x8 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
          side_plank_knee_touch 2x6 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          spine_flex_stretch 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 45m "Light Cardio & Mobility":
        warmup:
          brisk_house_walk 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          step_touch_to_squat 3x8 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
          hip_abduction_series 2x6 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          full_body_release_6_minutes
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower-Body Strength Intro":
        warmup:
          ankle_circles 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          chair_assisted_lunge 3x6 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
          glute_bridge_progress 3x8 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch_sequence 6 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper Body Stability":
        warmup:
          scapular_wcircuits 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_row_no_weight 3x8 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
          shoulder_external_rotation_no_weight 2x8 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_opener_5_minutes
      DAY Friday training 45m "Active Recovery & Mobility":
        warmup:
          gentle_walk 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          cat_cow_flow 3x8 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
          thoracic_mobility_sequence 4x6
        cooldown:
          deep_breathing_5_minutes
  PHASE "Phase 4" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Return-to-Load Foundation":
        warmup:
          light_walk 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bodyweight_squat_to_target 3x8 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
          incline_push_up_from_counter 3x6 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch_6_minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Dynamic Stability":
        warmup:
          breathing_focus 4 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          single_leg_stance_with_support 2x6 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
          glute_bridge_bridge_pulse 3x8 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist_6_minutes
      DAY Friday training 50m "Mobility & Posture Reset":
        warmup:
          shoulder_cues 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          wall_slide_series 3x8 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
          hip_dairies_46 2x6 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          full_body_release_7_minutes
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Cardio Foundation & Core":
        warmup:
          light_walk 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          step_to_walk_3x8 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
          dead_bug_progress 3x8 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          breathing_focus_6_minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Strength Seed (Restricted Abs)":
        warmup:
          pelvic_floor_breathing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          chair_supported_squat 3x8 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
          standing_row_with_tlex 2x8 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow_flow_6_minutes
      DAY Friday training 50m "Recovery & Gradual Load":
        warmup:
          gentle_walk 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thoracic_mobility 3x6 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
          thoracic_rotation_sit_5 4x6
        cooldown:
          guided_relaxation_6_minutes

SYNTAX RULES:
- Rep ranges use TWO dots, not a dash. Correct: 3x8..12. Correct: 2x6..8.
- Sets always come first: 3x10 means 3 sets of 10 reps.
- RPE goes after sets/reps: 3x8..12 rpe 7.
- Rest in seconds: rest 90 seconds.
